# Real macOS Bluetooth Low Energy IOHID capture, Stadia 18d1:9400.
# Labels for axes are based on byte offsets, not timed prompts (left-stick movement was delayed).
# name ID-prefixed-hex; no identifiers or timestamps.
# Central-button labels corrected from initial timed prompts using SDL and operator validation:
# 0x40 = left three dots (Options/Back), 0x20 = right three lines (Menu/Start). Raw bytes unchanged.
